task: PMOS vs NMOS shunt switch at the CTLE input common mode (entry 75)
library: FULL sky130.lib.spice tt (the trim carries no pfet yet)
why: entry 74 defect 1: the NMOS shunt switch is off at VCM = 1.5 V. This measures the replacement rather than assuming it, which is the mistake that produced the defect.

operating_point.note: the NMOS vth is 0.890 V, not its ~0.45 V nominal, because Vsb = 1.5 V: body effect on top of an already-inadequate Vgs.

nf_does_not_change_total_width.conclusion: W is the TOTAL width in the SKY130 subckt and nf only splits it into fingers. Ron is flat in nf and scales as 1/W. The per-FINGER width is what must stay in bin -- W=120 nf=1 is refused, W=120 nf=3 is fine.
